NAVAROSA Vice Mayor Municipality of Libacao Province of Aklan Dear Hon. Navarosa: This pertains to your Letter dated May 30, 2025 requesting this Department's legal opinion on the following issues, to wit: 1. 2. 3. 4. Clarify, and if necessary, re-evaluate the legal basis for allowing the assumption of office by the First and Second ranked Sangguniang Bayan Members for the 2022-2025 term, especially considering that such authority, pursuant to the Department's 23 May 2025 letter, may only pertain to the unexpired portion of the current term which ends on 30 June 2025. Confirm, through formal communication, that the said authority is understood to extend only until 30 June 2025, in line with the expiration of the incumbents' term and without prejudice to the outcome of the pending legal remedies; Consider withholding the issuance of any subsequent directive or confirmation of assumption beyond 30 June 2025, pending resolution of the undersigned's Motion for Reconsideration before the OMB and Petition for Certiorari before the CA. Kindly extend appropriate written guidance to local officials and stakeholders, in order to avoid confusion, prevent overlapping claims, and preserve the orderly and lawful transition of local leadership in a manner that upholds both legal propriety and the will of the electorate. per your letter, it appears that during the May 12, 2025 national and local election, you and your father, Mr. Charito Navarosa, were elected as Mayor and Vice Mayor, respectively, of the Municipality of Libacao, Aklan. However, prior to the election, an administrative case had been filed against you and your father, among others, in your capacity as Mayor and Vice Mayor before the OMB for Violation of Republic Act No. 6713, or the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees. In response to the OMB decision, you filed your Motion for Reconsideration, but despite this pending Motion, the Department issued "letters" on May 23, 2025 which were used as the basis for the assumption of office by the 1st and 2nd-Ranking Sangguniang Bayan Members (SBM) as Acting Mayor and Acting Vice Mayor, respectively, on May 27, 2025. Subsequently, on May 28, 2025, you filed a Petition for Certiorari with a prayer for a Temporary Restraining Order and/or Writ of Preliminary Injunction before the CA enjoining the implementation of the OMB decision and the assumption of office by the said acting SBM officials. Hence, your queries. While not cited in your letter, we note that the OMB Decision decreed you and your father dismissed from service for committing the administrative offense charged and we quote: "WHEREFORE, with this Office's finding of substantial evidence, respondent CHARITO INVENTADO NAVAROSA, VINCENT ICAMINA NAVAROSA x x x are held administratively liable for GRAVE MISCONDUCT. Accordingly, they are imposed a penalty of DISMISSAL FROM THE SERVICE with accessory penalties of cancellation of eligibility, forfeiture of retirement benefits, perpetual disqualification from holding public office and bar from taking civil service examination. x x x SO ORDERED." (Emphasis ours).l We shall addressed your queries in a single discussion. On June I I , 2025, this Department issued an Advisory regarding the assumption of office by elective officials with pending OMB cases but were elected in the May 2025 national and local elections. We clarified therein that elected officials whose administrative cases remain under review, such as those with pending Motions for Reconsideration, appeals, or other legal remedies, are not considered perpetually disqualified from holding public office. This includes cases where officials are in the process of seeking temporary relief from the courts, such as the issuance of a temporary restraining order or writ of preliminary injunction. Thus, this Department will recognize and honor the mandate and the assumption to duty of local officials elected in the 2025 elections whose orders of dismissal are pending review by competent authorities. It is clear then that you and your father, having been duly elected during the May 2025 national and local elections and with your respective administrative cases still pending final resolution, that is, your Motion for Reconsideration before the OMB and a Petition for Certiorari with a Prayer For Injunctive Relief before the CA — are not, at this point, deemed perpetually disqualified from assuming public office. Consequently, this Department recognizes you/ assumption of office as Mayor and Vice Mayor as valid and lawful on June 30, 2025, subject, however, to the outcome of the legal proceedings pending before the OMB and the higher courts. This opinion is rendered solely for academic discussion purposes, without prejudice to any contrary interpretation that may be issued by competent authorities or the courts or to any supervening developments arising from the resolution of any legal remedies which may have been or may still be resorted to.
